The issuer appears to have moderate balance-sheet leverage (liabilities of about 64% of assets) and a meaningful equity base, but liquidity is weak with a current ratio of 0.59 and operating profitability is only modest relative to its large liability load. The large retained earnings balance supports some resilience, yet the combination of thin near-term liquidity and only moderate earnings coverage is more consistent with the low end of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB-
